pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"each barber's license per state; skin care where the state licenses it","skills":"cuts, fades, beard work, razor shaves, kids cuts, beard color, house calls and events; only barbers who do color are offered for beard color","supervision":"apprentices and students work only under a licensed barber, where the state's rules allow","oks":"Sam OKs a group of 3 or more at the shop, a booking after a past dye reaction, and any wedding party quote over $500","standIn":"a barber out: another barber who does that service, at the same time and price; the stand-in gets the cut notes","away":"only barbers cleared for work away from the shop are offered for house calls and events","booth":"a booth renter's bookings are their own, never sent to the shop's owner"}

pluginText.pf.edges: {"lateArrival":"10 minutes' grace; 10 to 20 minutes late, a shorter cut in the time left or a later time; after 20 minutes it's a no-show, and the chair goes to walk-ins","walkInLong":"a walk-in runs long: the next booked customer hears the new start at once, and may move with no fee","standIn":"a barber out sick: another barber who does that service, at the same time and price, or new times with no fee","skinTest":"a skin test not done in time: later times that keep the 48 hours, or the cut without color","repeatNoShow":"after 2 no-shows or late cancels with no card, a card is needed to book (the owner's setting)","group":"a group of 3 or more: one booking, chairs side by side, Sam's OK first, one check-in code","weddingDay":"a wedding day can't move: a stand-in with the skill, or a full refund","fix":"a free fix-up within 7 days of a cut (the example shop's promise)","other":"all other edge cases the generic way"}
